nets.name: +3V3
nets.why: The controller supplies 3.3 V to the display and humidity sensor.

nets.name: GND
nets.why: All modules share a common ground reference.

nets.name: I2C_SCL
nets.why: GPIO22 supplies the shared I2C clock to the display and sensor.

nets.name: I2C_SDA
nets.why: GPIO21 exchanges I2C data with the display and sensor.

notes.text: Power the controller through USB; the sensor must receive only 3.3 V.
Keep the sensor exposed to room air and away from controller heat.
Check breakout pin labels and that I2C pull-ups connect to 3.3 V, not 5 V.

behavior.label: Display resolution
behavior.value: 1% RH for the relative humidity readout

input.summary: A USB-powered desk display that shows room humidity on a small OLED screen.
input.custom_firmware: Use the temp-monitor board layout with custom humidity-only firmware. Initialize I2C on SDA GPIO21 and SCL GPIO22 at 100 kHz. Detect the BME280 at 0x76 or 0x77 and SSD1306 128x64 OLED at 0x3C or 0x3D. Measure relative humidity every 2 seconds and display a large rounded integer with '% RH' and a smaller 'Humidity' label. Do not display temperature or pressure and do not implement alarms or controls. Until the first valid measurement show 'Reading...'. On sensor initialization failure or invalid/failed readings, replace the number with '-- % RH' and 'Sensor error', retrying sensor initialization every 2 seconds until recovered; never retain a stale number as a current reading.

input.summary: The firmware detects the OLED and BME280 on 100 kHz I2C, displays rounded humidity every two seconds, and replaces failed readings with a sensor error while retrying initialization.
